correctness.rationale: Every unital coefficient-field subalgebra in Fq[t]/(t^6) is k⊕W for a multiplication-closed radical subspace W of span{t,…,t⁵}. Echelon leading degrees are sum-closed below six; the six fixed ideals and six parametric types P24,P245,P3,P34,P35,P4 exhaust all possibilities, giving 6+3q+3q² subalgebras. Every automorphism is substitution t↦at+bt²+ct³+dt⁴+et⁵ with a≠0. Reduction of substitution on each echelon family establishes the displayed orbit strata: generic q has 12 orbits, characteristic 3 has 18 from square classes, and characteristic 2 has 16+gcd(3,q−1) from cube classes. Independent EXHAUSTIVE RREF enumeration of all radical subspaces and closure, with substitution-generated orbit graph, independently obtains q=2: 24 subalgebras/17 orbits, q=3: 42 subalgebras/18 orbits, and a separate F4 full-RREF and substitution calculation obtains 66 subalgebras/19 orbits with exact orbit-size profile 1^12,3^2,4^2,12^2,16^1. These finite tests are genuine finite certificates only for q=2,3,4; the manuscript’s parameter action algebra and cyclic multiplicative-group reasoning supply the uniform theorem.
